key.name: quota-interval
key.description: How often the collector asks each provider for plan usage. Anthropic rate-limits its usage endpoint hard, which is why this cannot go below two minutes. The Refresh button checks at once regardless.

key.name: hidden-tools
key.description: Ids of the tools to leave out: "claude", "kimi". A hidden tool disappears from the popup and the panel, and the collector stops reading its logs and asking its quota API.

key.name: popup-layout
key.description: tiles: every limit is its own raised tile. compact: one thin row per limit. numbers: a large percentage per limit.

key.name: pill-style
key.description: ring: a gauge and the percentage per agent. text: the agent's initial and the percentage, no gauge.
